notes.title: Patch 0.9.463
notes.content:
- Fixed problems in Prologue. Specfically: When character fell off bridge and got stuck.
- Fixed bug that allows for abuse of healing ability in "Abandoned Square"; healing ability can no longer be exploited and overused there. 
- Major tower in arena "Abandoned Square" now takea damage correctly and players can't avoid it.
- Added "Delete Character" button in character's window.
- In arena "The Library", now a bonus appears after 30 seconds when arena starts, not from very start as it was before.
- Fixed issue with changing windows mode.
- Corrected problem with lags when someone kills someone in arenas.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.462
notes.content:
- We're free-to-play. Now everyone can play Spellgear!
- All players, who purchased the game will receive a very precious gift.
- Implemented crafting system. Our first step in that direction.
- Based on your invaluable feedback, we've made huge changes in the battle system. Significantly expanded tactical abilities making them more dynamic, with added mobility.
- Implemented a clan system, so that we begin the steps to a clan war dynamic.
- Implemented global domination and global events.
- Lots of bug fixing. Always fun!

notes.title: Major patch 0.9.0456
notes.content:
- Improved the logic of minions; now, they inform each other about threats.
- Added a tutorial system.
- Added bots to "Abandoned Marketplace" arena.
- Improved graphics, improved customization, refined female faces, and optimized the sun shader, so owners of AMD cards no longer have to worry about greatly reduced FPS in the open world.
- Added time into the "Abandoned Marketplace" arena. All arenas have added counters: Kills, Deaths, and assists. 
- Added a list of arenas with descriptions in a special tab for the PvP Hub.
- Connected superiority point in the open world to "Stormy Island." Global confrontation started.
- Switched on the guards located at the bases of factions.

notes.title: Major patch is preparing
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you all so much for your awesome feedback! It’s incredibly important to us that we make Spellgear an immersive, fun, and interesting gaming experience. We have assessed every single bit of feedback, as well as going over improvement ideas ourselves, and we’re currently working on a major patch which should resolve many of the issues you’ve reported to us. The plan is to get this patch implemented in time to launch it on 9/2/2016.
